versions.subject: Merge PR #4712 from @prashanthpulisetti - Add a rule for Anydesk execution with known compromised certificate
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\AnyDesk.exe'
    - Description: 'AnyDesk'
    - Product: 'AnyDesk'
    - Company: 'AnyDesk Software GmbH'
selection_version:
    FileVersion|startswith:
        - '7.0.'
        - '7.1.'
        - '8.0.1'
        - '8.0.2'
        - '8.0.3'
        - '8.0.4'
        - '8.0.5'
        - '8.0.6'
        - '8.0.7'
filter_main_uninstall:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' --remove'
        - ' --uninstall'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\AnyDesk.exe" OR Description="AnyDesk" OR Product="AnyDesk" OR Company="AnyDesk Software GmbH" FileVersion IN ("7.0.*", "7.1.*", "8.0.1*", "8.0.2*", "8.0.3*", "8.0.4*", "8.0.5*", "8.0.6*", "8.0.7*") NOT (CommandLine IN ("* --remove*", "* --uninstall*"))
